senses.gloss: Kavacin, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2738.--§ 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4550.-§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 51, 2446 (attacked Bhīmasena); 84^1, 4262 (do., is slain by Bhīmasena).
Kavasha, a ṛshi. § 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7596 (one of the ṛshis of the west).
Kāverakā, a river in Śākadvīpa. § 575b (Śākadvīpa): VI, 11, 432.

Kāverī, a river. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 372 (among the rivers present in the palace of Varuṇa).--§ 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 85, 8164 (a tīrtha).--§ 459 (Mārkāṇḍeyas.): III, 188, 12910 (among the rivers seen by Mārkāṇḍeya in the stomach of Nārāyaṇa).--§ 494 (Āṅgirasa): III, 222, 14232 (among the rivers who are mothers of fires).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 328 (in Bhāratavarsha).--§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7646, 7648.

Kavi^1, a ṛshi. § 121 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2606 (son of Bhṛgu and father of Uśanas (Śukra), cf. Nīl. ad. I, 3204).-§ 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4123 (sprang together with Bhṛgu and Aṅgiras from the sacrificial fire (viz. from the extinguished coals) into which the seed of Brahmán had fallen), 4142 (was adopted by Brahmán), 4149 (had eight sons named Vāruṇāḥ), 4151 (ºsutāḥ), 4152, 4153 (adopted by Śiva in the shape of Varuṇa).--§ 751b (Śapathavidhi): XIII, 94, †4550, (4578).
Kavi^4, a son of Kavi^1. § 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4150 (first son of Kavi).
Kaviputra (“the son of Kavi”) = Śukra (Uśanas): I, 3204.
Kāvya^1, a son of Kavi^1. § 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4150 (second son of Kavi^1 = Śukra?).--Do.^2 = Śukra, q.v.
